headline: Analog Devices authors report power-aware RNM verification with schematic correlation
fact: An Analog Devices-authored presentation reports power-aware RNM models used with UVM supply and interrupt agents and assertions. It describes validating models against schematics, scripting chip-top connectivity, and running RNM with RTL; the authors report finding isolation and sequencing bugs and closing coverage without mixed-signal co-simulation for those full-chip tests.

sources.title: Taking RNM Model to the Next Level: Power-Aware Verification of Mixed-Signal Designs
sources.summary: 2019 Analog Devices presentation on power-aware RNM, model-to-schematic validation, scripted integration, assertions, and coverage.
